description: Exact original static runtime Airfield mesh positions, triangle indices, computed normals, UVs, material values and procedural texture pixels. Both physical fork roads are exported independently. Lighting, shaders and renderer differ from PlayCanvas. No gameplay/GPU capture or frame-rate claim; no racing driver, kart, HUD or downloaded asset. Connected rolling dry uplands follow the graded road; the steel hangar has thick opaque asymmetric split roof panels and literal open ridge/end gables. Original static aviation-inspired exhibits retain their joined members and full-footprint supports.
renderer: Blender 4.3.2 Cycles CPU, 2 threads, 48 samples. Fixed original source-derived cameras. No gameplay/GPU or FPS claim.

normalShading.storage: Exact float32 source normal FLOAT_VECTOR POINT attribute, source (x,y,z) to Blender (x,-z,y)
normalShading.shader: Attribute Vector -> object-to-world NORMAL -> normalize -> multiply (1 - 2 * Backfacing) -> Principled BSDF Normal
normalShading.notice: Exact source normal data and two-sided transform convention; approximate offline material/light response

airfield-overview.name: airfield-overview
airfield-overview.description: Complete original Copperwing Airfield circuit: long launch runway, graded reversing ridge, actual dry ochre/sage/clay contours, both physical Hangar Cut and Perimeter Taxiway, open split-roof steel hangar and five original aviation-inspired exhibits. Exact emitted source geometry; approximate offline CPU lighting, materials and shadows.

airfield-topdown.name: airfield-topdown
airfield-topdown.description: True vertical overhead original source geometry, both complete physical alternatives and owned split/merge unions. Actual road widths, graded reversing ridge, long runway and descent, continuous dry terrain, hangar roof and museum exhibits remain unchanged. No source mesh is hidden to expose roads.

airfield-driver-reveal.name: airfield-driver-reveal
airfield-driver-reveal.description: Frozen source-design driver eye on the real launch runway at exactly 1.6 m above physical road support, aimed at the actual emitted Twinboom Courier source sightline target. Closed crescent wings, paired tail booms, original landing gear and connected dry runway bank remain unchanged. This source-derived review aim/lens differs from the shared gameplay chase camera; no HUD or vehicle, approximate offline CPU lighting/materials.

airfield-hangar-architecture.name: airfield-hangar-architecture
airfield-hangar-architecture.description: Actual Hangar Cut support before the first portal, eye exactly 1.6 m above physical road. Opaque asymmetric roof sheets have source thickness and a literal open ridge slot; steel portal, rafters, webs, purlins, lattice braces, shoes and full-footprint foundations remain enabled. A legitimate narrow lattice brace can cross the open slot; no filled panel or blocker is hidden. Architectural upward aim and recorded wide lens differ from gameplay.

airfield-rotor-detail.name: airfield-rotor-detail
airfield-rotor-detail.description: Original Rotor Cutaway Court: nine stationary thick rooted fan blades, joined hub and continuous shaft, paired visible bearing saddles, partial open casing rings, ribs, braces and grounded sled. All source terrain, road and museum meshes remain visible and unmodified. Static architectural detail camera; approximate offline CPU lighting/materials, no moving rotor or gameplay claim.
